get.description: Returns some of the configuration values.

Aggregated statistics for a datetime range [start, end): created and expired users, total traffic, traffic spent by users created within the range and new HWID devices. Per-user traffic history is stored with daily granularity (UTC), so the "traffic by new users" metric snaps to whole days at the range edges.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 datetime with timezone (e.g. 2026-07-15T00:00:00Z). Inclusive.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 datetime with timezone (e.g. 2026-07-16T00:00:00Z). Exclusive.

info.title: Remnawave API v3.4.11
info.description:
Remnawave is a powerful proxy management tool, built on top of Xray-core, with a focus on simplicity and ease of use.

## Resources
* https://t.me/remnawave
* https://github.com/remnawave
* https://docs.rw

tags.name: Users Controller
tags.description: Manage users, change their status, reset traffic, etc.

tags.name: [Public] Subscription Controller
tags.description: Public Subscription Controller. Methods of this controller are not protected with auth. Use it only for public requests.

tags.name: [Protected] Subscriptions Controller
tags.description: Methods of this controller are protected with auth, most of them is returning the same informations as public Subscription Controller.

tags.name: Connections Controller
tags.description: Management of connections by user and node.

tags.name: Keygen Controller
tags.description: Generation of SECRET_KEY for Remnawave Node.

tags.name: Metadata Controller
tags.description: Manage arbitrary metadata for Users and Nodes.

tags.name: API Tokens Controller
tags.description: Manage API tokens to use in your code. This controller can't be used with API token, only with Admin JWT token

expiresInDays.description: Expiration days of the API token

excludeFromSubscriptionTypes.description: Optional. Subscription types from which the host will be excluded from.

username.description: Unique username for the user. Required. Must be 3-36 characters long and contain only letters, numbers, underscores and dashes.

shortUuid.description: Optional. Short UUID identifier for the user.

trojanPassword.description: Optional. Password for Trojan protocol. Must be 8-32 characters.

vlessUuid.description: Optional. UUID for VLESS protocol. Must be a valid UUID format.

ssPassword.description: Optional. Password for Shadowsocks protocol. Must be 8-32 characters.

trafficLimitBytes.description: Optional. Traffic limit in bytes. Set to 0 for unlimited traffic.

lastTrafficResetAt.description: Optional. Date of last traffic reset. Format: 2025-01-17T15:38:45.065Z

description.description: Optional. Additional notes or description for the user account.

tag.description: Optional. User tag for categorization. Max 16 characters, uppercase letters, numbers and underscores only.

telegramId.description: Optional. Telegram user ID for notifications. Must be an integer.

email.description: Optional. User email address. Must be a valid email format.

hwidDeviceLimit.description: Optional. Maximum number of hardware devices allowed. Must be a positive integer.

activeInternalSquads.description: Optional. Array of UUIDs representing enabled internal squads.

ignoreServeJsonAtBaseSubscription.title: Ignore Serve Json at Base Subscription

days.description: The number of days to extend the expiration date.

rawReport.description: The full node report with the image object stripped out

data.description: Base64-encoded image, ready for a data: URL

nextCursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next page, or null if there are no more results

hasMore.description: Whether there are more results to fetch

totalBytes.description: Used bytes on this node that day (raw bytes)
Total used bytes over the period (raw bytes)

RemnawaveError.description: Error payload returned by the Remnawave panel for any non-success status code.

timestamp.description: Time when the error occurred, in ISO 8601 format.

path.description: Path of the request that caused the error.

errorCode.description:
Error code. Possible values:

- `A019` — User username already exists
- `A020` — User short UUID already exists
- `A021` — User subscription UUID already exists
- `A029` — User already disabled
- `A030` — User already enabled
- `A033` — Node name already exists
- `A034` — Node address already exists
- `A045` — Host remark already exists
- `A089` — LIMITED and EXPIRED statuses are not allowed to be set manually.
- `A098` — User hwid device already exists
- `A099` — User hwid device limit reached
- `A144` — This name is reserved by Remnawave. Please use a different name.
- `A145` — This name is reserved by Remnawave. Please use a different name.
- `A149` — Node is disabled
- `A152` — Name or config is required
- `A153` — Name or inbounds is required
- `A164` — Snippet name already exists
- `A166` — Snippet cannot be empty
- `A167` — Snippet cannot contain empty objects
- `A172` — This name is reserved. Please use a different name.
- `A173` — Template JSON is not allowed for YAML template
- `A174` — Template YAML is not allowed for JSON template
- `A175` — Template JSON and YAML cannot be updated simultaneously
- `A176` — Template name already exists for this type
- `A178` — Reserved template cannot be deleted
- `A180` — Template type not allowed
- `A189` — External squad name already exists
- `A190` — Name or templates are required
- `A194` — Passkeys not configured
- `A195` — Passkeys not enabled. Please enable it first.
- `A209` — Reserved config name
- `A210` — Config name already exists
- `A212` — Reserved subpage config cannot be deleted
- `A215` — Invalid subscription page config
- `A216` — Invalid Remnawave injector
- `A223` — Node plugin name already exists
- `A229` — One or more provided API token scopes are invalid
- `A230` — Either nodeUuid or name must be provided
- `A235` — Start date must be before or equal to end date
- `A244` — Node integration name already exists
- `A246` — Shared list name already exists

nodeId.description: Node ID the snapshot belongs to (bigint as string).

ts.description: Time the snapshot was exported (ISO 8601, UTC).

users.description:
JSON-encoded array of users connected to the node with their IPs.
Example:
```json
[{ "userId": "42", "ips": [{ "ip": "1.2.3.4", "lastSeen": "2026-07-16T11:59:30.000Z" }] }]
```

RemnawaveNodeConnectionsStreamMessageDto.description: A single message of the "ioraw:export:node_connections" Redis Stream (EXPORT_TO_STREAM_ENABLED). Snapshot of connections on one node; retention is time-based.

userId.description: ID of the user who requested the subscription (bigint as string).

requestAt.description: Time of the subscription request (ISO 8601, UTC).

requestIp.description: Client IP address, omitted if unknown.

srrRuleName.description: SRR rule name, omitted if unknown.

RemnawaveSubscriptionRequestStreamMessag.description: A single message of the "ioraw:export:subscription_requests" Redis Stream (EXPORT_TO_STREAM_ENABLED).

nodeId.description: Node ID the batch belongs to (bigint as string).

ts.description: Time the batch was exported (ISO 8601, UTC).

records.description: User traffic deltas: "userId:totalBytes" pairs separated by ";".

RemnawaveUserUsageStreamMessageDto.description: A single message of the "ioraw:export:user_usage" Redis Stream (EXPORT_TO_STREAM_ENABLED).

path.description: Path to the field that failed validation.

revokeOnlyPasswords.description: Optional. If true, only passwords will be revoked, without changing the short UUID (Subscription URL).

shortUuid.description: Optional. If not provided, a new short UUID will be generated by Remnawave. Please note that it is strongly recommended to allow Remnawave to generate the short UUID.

excludeFromSubscriptionTypes.description: Optional. Subscription types from which the host will be excluded from.
Optional. Subscription types from which the host will be excluded from.

UserStatus.description: Optional. User account status. Defaults to ACTIVE.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next page, or null if there are no more results

hasMore.description: Whether there are more results to fetch
